risks.risk: Exact part/engine identification is unclear, so the wrong unit could be supplied (wrong engine/variant/compatibility).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the engine/part identification plate or stamping (engine code) and the full label/part number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used engine/component with compatibility risk (worst-case: may not fit).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” may be false; the unit could have internal faults not visible in a photo.
risks.proof: Request a short video of the engine running from cold (or at least start + idle) and/or a diagnostic scan showing no critical faults.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as faulty/needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Mileage claim may be inaccurate; ECU/odometer data may not match.
risks.proof: Request a screenshot/photo of ECU mileage/vehicle history or a diagnostic report showing mileage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown mileage (worst-case: treat as higher wear).

risks.risk: “Never opened” may be untrue; seals/gaskets may have been replaced or the unit may have been repaired before.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of seals, gasket lines, and any tamper marks/fastener condition; also ask for a photo of the underside/cover areas.
risks.if_unproven: Price as previously opened/unknown service history (worst-case: reduced value).

risks.risk: Shipping/handling damage (connectors, sensors, mounts) may exist but isn’t fully visible.
risks.proof: Request close-ups of all connectors, sensors, mounting points, and any visible cracks/repairs; include a photo of the full unit from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/needs inspection (worst-case: deduct for missing/failed parts).

proof_requests: Clear photos of the engine/part code plate or stamped engine code (and any visible part number).
Video of the engine starting and idling (or diagnostic scan report with fault codes).
Diagnostic screenshot showing mileage/ECU data (or vehicle history document).
Close-up photos of seals/gaskets and mounting points to support “never opened” and check for damage.
response.reason: From photo 0, the exact engine/part identity and working condition cannot be confirmed, and the seller’s key claims (tested/no knock/low mileage/never opened) are not provable remotely without diagnostic or running proof.
